content.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.general_info: The document is a clinical guideline focused on cardiovascular complications in the context of cancer therapies and heart failure management. It lists numerous studies and articles relevant to the effects of various cancer treatments on cardiac health.

sections.title: Cardiotoxicity and Cancer Treatments
sections.details: Multiple entries discuss the cardiotoxic effects of cancer treatments, including anthracyclines, trastuzumab, and fluoropyrimidines, with a focus on monitoring and management strategies. Specific drugs and regimens mentioned include Doxorubicin, Cyclophosphamide, and Trastuzumab.

sections.title: Biomarkers for Cardiotoxicity
sections.details: Studies focused on identifying biomarkers for early detection and monitoring of cardiotoxicity induced by cancer therapies are discussed. Troponins and natriuretic peptides are mentioned as potential biomarkers.

sections.title: Drug-Induced Cardiac Dysfunction
sections.details: Drugs such as Imatinib, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor, are noted for their potential to induce cardiac dysfunction, with specific cases and outcomes described.
